scope: CPU-only local source/provenance audit of the existing native64 component-gradient comparison. No remote access, Torch import, model, GPU, forward, backward, optimizer, normalization, deployment or production edit performed.

policy_and_carrier_provenance.sequence: Original WG loads both rank model/optimizer/extra state from checkpoint25; native collector begins its first post-restore iteration26; original trainer recomputes old_log_probs with actor.compute_log_prob before DT/advantage and native update boundary; observer substitutes only diagnostic advantages for GRPO and does not rewrite old_log_probs, ref_log_prob or native forward log_prob.
policy_and_carrier_provenance.checkpoint_and_actor_policy_scope: Same restored checkpoint25 actor weights, no intervening optimizer update. The recorded global_step26 is the new bounded diagnostic iteration after restore, not the earlier production iteration26.
policy_and_carrier_provenance.limit: Source/phase evidence binds actor old/current weights to checkpoint25. No rollout_log_probs or per-token vLLM dynamic weight/logprob identity was saved in this carrier; exact actor/sampler per-token distribution equality is not dynamically proved. Zero recorded masked-mean PPO KL does not itself prove every token ratio equals one.

advantage_contracts.DT: Actual trainer361-373 uses original FP32 dt_token_advantages with response_mask zeroing; advantages=raw DT A and returns=Q. Fixed A=g[-expm1(-d)] remains unnormalized. G=0 policy-action coefficients are zero by this specified formula.
advantage_contracts.GRPO: Actual core113-174 sums original reward over response positions, computes mean and torch.std within each uid group, centers scores and divides by std+1e-6 under norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=True, then broadcasts through response/loss_mask. This native64 has eight groups of eight. G0 actions in a mixed group can receive negative coefficients; all-zero groups receive zero. The function does not call masked_whiten.
advantage_contracts.GRPO_default_norm_false: Turning off group std normalization still subtracts the uid-group mean; it is not a raw-return or pure-scale path.
advantage_contracts.masked_whiten_default: Actual helper170-187 computes masked mean and unbiased masked variance, then returns (A-mean)/sqrt(var+1e-8) at every position, with no final remask. shift_mean=True therefore includes centering and changes signs/support, not only magnitude.
advantage_contracts.G0_effect: When the masked mean is nonzero, raw-zero G0 action positions inside loss_mask acquire nonzero -mean/sigma training coefficients under masked_whiten; multiplying by the original loss_mask afterwards does not remove them.
advantage_contracts.O_padding_effect: The helper can produce nonzero raw values at masked-out O/padding positions too because it does not remask. Original actor loss_mask tail still excludes those positions, so helper output nonzero there is not evidence of nonzero training loss. This audit does not add masked_whiten to DT.
advantage_contracts.shift_mean_false: The helper re-adds the original mean after centering/scaling: (A-mean)/sigma+mean. Except special cases this is also not A/sigma.
advantage_contracts.batch_scope: Existing trainer GAE/REINFORCE calls apply masked_whiten to the entire centralized incoming response tensor before actor DP dispatch, with axis=None masked stats; applying that existing seam to this saved64 would use global64 active-token statistics. GRPO instead computes per-uid group score statistics. No whitening is performed inside actor B4 or in current DT.
advantage_contracts.PLAN: Current PLAN fixes token Q/V/A and does not authorize DT centering, whitening or arbitrary coefficient scaling. No such change was implemented.

shared_native_loss.partition: global64 -> original DP chunk2 -> each local32 -> eight consecutive B4; original token-mean in each B4 uses the entire original action loss_mask tail; each microbatch loss divides by8 before backward. Both DT and GRPO use this same original denominator. Global pooled mass is not this loss weight.
shared_native_loss.formula: Original actor loss = PG - 0.001*H + 0.001*low_var_KL; all three use original loss mask and the same microbatch aggregation/accumulation. Entropy and reference KL remain outside PPO PG clipping.
shared_native_loss.clipping: Original clipped/dual-clipped PG depends on ratio=exp(current LP-old LP) and advantage sign. It does not normalize A or clip H/KL, and zero PG clip fraction is not a bound on entropy-driven or Adam-driven cumulative policy drift.
shared_native_loss.positive_scale_geometry: For a fixed native forward, oldLP and mask, any strictly positive uniform scalar on A preserves native clipped/dual-clip branch choice and multiplies the PG loss/gradient by that scalar. Centering need not preserve sign, branch choice, G0 support or PG direction. This is a source algebra description, not an implemented credit change.

observed_magnitude_and_direction.interpretation: The actual task-vs-regularizer imbalance is measured under the unchanged PPO objective. The 1/211 comparison is raw token DT versus group-centered/std-normalized GRPO, not a unit-free DT quality score. Existing near-orthogonal PG direction also rules out DT being merely a positive uniform rescaling of that GRPO gradient; GRPO is not a correctness oracle. Positive DT dot total gradient means entropy norm dominance alone does not establish an inverse DT-PG SGD direction; original Adam dynamics must be interpreted from saved native updates.

minimal_next_diagnostic_boundary.already_available_no_retest: Use the existing original-owner Gram and complete original-mask support measurements to report magnitude separately from unit-vector alignment. They already distinguish a pure uniform-scale relation from an actual direction difference without changing A.
minimal_next_diagnostic_boundary.what_is_not_identified: These observations do not determine whether the direction difference is beneficial token-specific credit or reward-readout error, nor prove that a different DT scale would improve reward or the historical trajectory.
minimal_next_diagnostic_boundary.if_scale_intervention_is_later_authorize: A bounded same64/samecheckpoint native observer comparison could change only a uniform positive coefficient on the original DT advantage while preserving G0, O/padding masks, old/ref LP and the original B4/8 denominator. That would isolate magnitude; masked_whiten would confound magnitude with centering and support. Such an intervention currently conflicts with fixed PLAN and remains unimplemented, not a proposed production repair.
minimal_next_diagnostic_boundary.readout_quality_scope: Use already saved whole-response native factual/EOS target effects and original-author cumulative deletion curves to assess the unchanged readout independently of PG magnitude. Normalized curve shape and endpoint conservation do not establish native world-value accuracy or individual token marginal accuracy.
